test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select an appropriate title for the given passage.

options.text: Personalised Learning Aims at Teachers’ Strength
Technology Formats to Assess Students’ Intellect

solution: The correct answer is **Option (4).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage discusses **the shift towards personalised learning that prioritises individual student’s needs, making education student-centric. **(paragraph 1) • It emphasises learner autonomy where students design their own learning pathways and the teacher mentor them. (paragraph 3) **Therefore, the correct answer is "Student-Centric Pedagogy Fosters Learner Autonomy".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Option (1)** is not suitable because the passage **does not focus specifically on teachers' strengths** but rather on how personalised learning involves both teacher and technology. • **Option (2) **is incorrect as the passage mentions technology's role but not solely about assessing students' intellect. • **Option (3)** doesn’t capture the main idea of the passage which revolves around student-centric learning and not just content trends. **Some Important Words, used in the passage.__** • **Vogue **- Popular or fashionable at a particular time. (प्रचलन - किसी विशेष समय पर लोकप्रिय या फैशनेबल।) • **Schemata** - Plural of schema; organized patterns or frameworks of thought or behavior. (आरेखन पद्धति - विचार या व्यवहार के संगठित पैटर्न या ढांचे।) • **Privileged **- Having special rights, advantages, or immunities. (विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त - विशेष अधिकार, लाभ, या छूट का होना।) 98:T764, The correct answer is **Option (1).**
